description: The European Central Bank's daily reference exchange rate for a base currency, from the free Frankfurter API. Returns the rate table for the requested base on the latest published business day, or on a past date. When an agent needs this data as a clean, typed, pay-per-call API rather than integrating the upstream itself. Do not use when the buyer needs the upstream's raw, unnormalised payload, or a write to the upstream — this product is read-only. Example requests: convert GBP to USD at today's ECB reference rate | which currencies does the ECB reference rate cover | the EUR/USD reference rate on a past date

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

params.description: A JSON object of the operation's parameters, e.g. {"base": "GBP", "operation": "latest", "symbols": "USD"}. The operation and its parameters are validated before any upstream call.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_gbp_usd_rate

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Reference Exchange Rate
